articles.title: Showa American Story: The First Hands-On Preview
articles.summary: Showa American Story succeeds in crafting an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world. However, its deliberate jank and niche style mean its general polish still lags behind other modern AAA action games at this point.
body: Showa American Story is, if nothing else, a profoundly wacky action-RPG. Five years have passed since its initial reveal in 2021, and with barely any updates in recent years, players have been left wondering: In an era where the Chinese AAA single-player market is rapidly expanding, can a game with such an eccentric tone actually carve out its own identity?

We recently had the chance to go hands-on with about two hours of Showa American Story. Based on an introduction by Creative Director Xiangyu Luo and our own gameplay experience, here is what makes this absurd adventure tick. Luo describes Showa American Story as an RPG overflowing with retro pop culture. Set in an alternate late-'80s where Japan bought up most of the United States, effectively colonizing it economically and culturally, players take control of Choko Chigusa—a girl brought back from the dead. She embarks on a road trip filled with combat, exploration, and growth across a world that feels both absurdly bizarre and weirdly familiar.
points: Showa American Story succeeds in crafting an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world.

articles.title: CBS's Legendary 156-Episode Sci-Fi Anthology Series is Officially Free to Watch on Streaming
articles.summary: In the realm of science fiction, Star Wars and Star Trek are generally considered to be the two biggest franchises. And, if you’re purely talking about profitability, that’s correct, as those two have dominated TV and film for decades.
body: In the realm of science fiction, pretty much all roads lead to, or derive from, The Twilight Zone. And this landmark show is currently free to stream on Tubi.

Debuting in 1959, The Twilight Zone ran for five seasons on CBS, totaling 156 episodes. It was created by Rod Serling, a television pioneer who sought to expand what had been seen on television throughout the 1950s, much of which was taped plays and multi-camera sitcoms like I Love Lucy. To do this, he created The Twilight Zone, a single-camera anthology series where each episode would operate like a little movie (for most of its run, the show ran for a half-hour, but season 4 tried out an hour-long format before switching back to half-hours for season 5).

While every episode of The Twilight Zone has its own characters and premise, it often explores science fiction subjects like time travel and aliens, as well as horror staples like ghosts and possessed dolls. But that was just the surface-level stuff, as many of the deeper messages in the series tackled things like prejudice, loneliness, morality, and regret.
points: In the realm of science fiction, Star Wars and Star Trek are generally considered to be the two biggest franchises.

articles.title: Konami Partners With Celebrity Kitty to Release Metal Gear Cat Toys at CatCon 2026
articles.summary: Konami is partnering up with a celebrity kitty named ‘one-eared Uno’ to debut a special Metal Gear cat toy collection available at CatCon 2026. If you didn’t know there was a cat convention, now you do.
body: One of those cats, affectionately named ‘one-eared Uno,’ and her owner, Kat Curtis, will host a special meet-and-greet event at the Konami booth at CatCon this year to celebrate the release of some special Metal Gear-themed cat toys.

These offerings include cat scratch boxes modeled after the iconic cardboard boxes that Big Boss and Old Snake use to sneak around without being detected by enemies, plush pet toys, and even cat collars inspired by Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots.

The lovable one-eared Uno with her adorable underbite was rescued by Kat as a stray, who found the kitty abandoned near a dumpster. The two now boast over five million followers on social media and are meeting fans at Catcon on October 12 at 2 PM PST.

CatCon takes place at the Pasadena Convention Center from October 10 - 11. Cat lovers will be able to score the Snake-approved merch for their kitties on those days only, both at the convention and online via the OKS Gear Shop.

articles.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups Review
articles.summary: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups review: A sloppy gangster epic finds Indian megastar Yash in the mood for blood.
body: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups will be released on August 26.

Equally anesthetic is the litany of breakneck action. For the majority of its runtime, Toxic’s story is told by way of some rival faction or another opening fire on Raya’s crew as he overcomes the odds, but actually tracing who’s who — or why anyone is doing anything at all — is a fool’s errand. You could certainly turn your brain off to the movie’s flip-book unfurling, but watching Toxic might just require you to turn your eyes off from time to time too. The sheer number of cuts with no legible point of focus or geography is disorienting to say the least.

Sadly, the film’s sloppy assembly doesn’t end at its visual construction. Musically, it’s stuck in the early-to-mid aughts, drawing from the soundtracks of international blockbuster and arthouse darlings of the era — In The Mood for Love, Donnie Darko, Requiem for a Dream, even The Dark Knight — without much by way of originality or coherent sonic identity.
points: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups review: A sloppy gangster epic finds Indian megastar Yash in the mood for blood.

articles.title: Taylor Sheridan and Jon Bernthal's 121-minute 10/10 Action Western Remains a Streaming Smash Hit
articles.summary: Jon Bernthal is enjoying one of the biggest years of his career. Between high-profile roles in The Odyssey and Spider-Man: Brand New Day — easily two of the biggest movies of the summer — the actor has become one of Hollywood's most in-demand supporting stars.
body: Right now, one of Bernthal's finest crime thrillers is finding a new life. More than a decade after its theatrical release, a 121-minute action masterpiece has become a streaming hit on HBO Max with surprising staying power, finding a whole new audience in 2026.

The movie making an unexpected comeback is Denis Villeneuve's 2015 crime thriller Sicario. After landing on HBO Max at the start of August, the Taylor Sheridan-penned thriller has quickly found a new audience and sprinted to the streamer's top 10 ranking, according to third-party tracker FlixPatrol. Earlier in August, Sicario was hovering at #7 on the list, but as of Aug. 25 it's hit #6, suggesting that our collective Jon Bernthal fever still hasn't broken.
Twenty movies. Four choices each. How well do you know summer at the cinema?

articles.title: Gravhounds Reveal Trailer Sends Good Boys Into A Sci-Fi Battle
articles.summary: Gamescom Opening Night Live is always full of surprises, and this year, indie developer Octopus Panic made a splash with a first look at its new action-builder game Gravhounds.
body: Although the trailer states that the titular Gravhounds have been "bred" for this life, their humanoid appearance suggests more than a little genetic engineering was responsible for this turn of events. In fact, there's no sign of human life at all on this hostile alien world, but the Gravhounds themselves seem human enough.

The gameplay supports 1-4 players as they attempt to build up resources for a new colony while holding on to the potential promise of coming home. Upgrades appear to play a major role in the main characters' survival, especially when they get overwhelmed by alien forces that really don't want them around at all.

According to Gravhounds' Steam page, the game's early-access period will last at least six months. It will "include the core Gravhound experience," but we plan to expand its breadth, depth, and replayability on the road to 1.0," reads the statement. Both solo and co-op campaigns will be playable during this initial release.
Gravhounds' early-access release will hit Xbox Series X|S and PC on November 2. It will also be available on day one with Xbox Game Pass.

articles.summary: If you pay attention to comics communities online, there are a few dozen out-of-context scenes and panels that are in constant circulation. Every year or two, someone's just seen some joke for the first time, so they reshare it and that sends it around again, like the time Deadpool landed a…
body: This is a deep cut for anyone who knows DC Comics’ history, but the Brown Bomber is a version of an unused character who led directly to the creation of one of DC’s premiere superheroes: Jefferson Pierce, better known as Black Lightning. Jeff is also the star of a surprisingly faithful TV adaptation that got four seasons and 58 episodes on the CW between 2018 and 2021 as part of the sprawling "Arrowverse." If you're interested in a quick binge, Black Lightning has one more week on Netflix before it leaves on Aug. 31.

The story of the “Black Bomber” comes from Jenny Isabella, Black Lightning’s co-creator, in her introduction to the 2016 trade paperback that collected the first volume of Black Lightning. The Bomber began as the star of a planned new series from DC circa 1977. As conceived, the Bomber was a bigoted white Vietnam veteran who had developed the power to turn into a Black superhero "in moments of stress."

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Gamescom Trailer Is All About The Weapons
articles.summary: Following its official reveal at Summer Games Fest, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation made another appearance at Gamescom Opening Night Live, following a brief introduction from director Naoki Hamaguchi.
body: The cinematic trailer showed Rufus Shinra giving an address following recent world events, and the world has become overrun with Weapons. Those kaiju-like beasts were a part of the original Final Fantasy 7, including as optional bosses, but they seem to have a much bigger role in the story here. In dialogue the cast talks about them being guardians of the planet, and humans are seen as a harmful invasive species. The trailer showed off Ultima Weapon and Emerald Weapon in particular, but there may be more.

The trailer also showed off a good bit of the full cast, an aerial battle in Cid's Highwind, and ground battles against familiar Final Fantasy foes like Typhon (aka Mr. Chupon, for you old-school fans).

articles.title: 'The Dog Stars Review: Ridley Scott's New Sci-Fi Odyssey Is an Action Movie Like No Other
articles.summary: Quiet, contemplative moments like these keep The Dog Stars grounded and accessible throughout its sprawling post-apocalyptic story — even as director Ridley Scott piles on epic action set pieces and surreal, surprising sequences that sometimes push the film from prestige drama into absurdist…
body: Hig pilots his small, vintage plane up into the Colorado mountains, cuts the engine, and glides. Surrounded by endless sky and soft green forest, there’s a look of uneasy peace on the young man’s face. Serenity, grief, and a glimmer of a death wish swirl together against the canvas of Jacob Elordi’s perpetual 5 o'clock shadow as he soars silently through the air, waiting until the last possible minute to restart the engine and fly back home.

In The Dog Stars, based on the 2012 book of the same name by Peter Heller and adapted by screenwriter Mark L. Smith ( The Revenant ), Elordi’s Hig is one of the few remaining survivors on Earth, years after a deadly virus swept the planet. He lives on an old airfield with a former marine named Bangley (Josh Brolin). All things considered, they have a pretty good life — plenty of whiskey, cigarettes, bullets, and the safety of a secure perimeter — but Hig wants something more.

articles.title: Solasta 2 is getting multiplayer and warlocks in its next update
articles.summary: While gameplay footage of the upcoming D&D game shows off a solo warlock, if you'd like to play a warlock as a member of a classic party of adventurers then Solasta 2's next update has got your back.
body: Up to four people will be able to join the same multiplayer session, whether starting a new game or joining one already in progress. The host can assign a new player an existing character, or they can bring an existing one, or create a new one on the spot. Control of companions who join your party can also be split up as you go. Every player gets a vote on the big story and dialogue choices, and there's a ping system being added to help you communicate.

New features for people like me who want an entire gang of characters to ourselves include expanded customization (with more hairstyles, tattoos, warpaint, and beards), the option to roll your stats randomly, spell component rules being made optional so you can choose between accuracy to the rulebook or something simpler, roughly 30 extra world events to find while exploring, cloud saves, and a way to switch into cautious mode while playing with a controller.
points: While gameplay footage of the upcoming D&D game shows off a solo warlock, if you'd like to play a warlock as a member of a classic party of adventurers then Solasta 2's next update has got your back.

articles.title: Paradox's latest grand strategy Afterworld wants you to survive and thrive in the post-apocalypse
articles.summary: After a succession of grand strategy sequels - including Crusader Kings 3, Victoria 4, and Europa Universalis 5 - Paradox has unveiled Afterworld, its first grand strategy game to feature an original setting in over a decade.
body: As its name hints at, Afterworld whisks strategy fans to a post-apocalyptic future; specifically a post-apocalyptic North America blighted with hazardous terrain, dangerous old-world ruins, and the desperate remnants of humanity. Through this hostile, procedurally generated landscape, players must slowly grow a small group of survivors into a continent-spanning empire - by first scavenging food, water, and shelter, before rediscovering the basic methods of civilisation and expanding from there.

Paradox describes Afterworld as a "story rich" strategy game, beginning with players choosing one of several origin stories for their group - perhaps they've been forced to abandon a failed nuclear bunker, or are "wayward zealots looking for their goddess in the dustlands". Then as the group grows, they'll learn new skills and rediscover technologies (all unlocked dynamically based on what players find as they explore), set up convoys and supply lines, encounter rival groups, negotiate trades, and fight wars where necessary.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered announced, an overhaul free for existing owners, while expansion Songs of the Past finally shown
articles.summary: The Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past - which is due to arrive 12 years after the base game was released - has finally been detailed in a debut trailer, but the surprise news is there's also a The Witcher 3 - Remastered edition coming that considerably overhauls the game, and it'll be a free…
body: Remastered also sounds like a considerable effort. It's been co-developed with a studio called Yigsoft, and not only does it offer visual and performance enhancements but gameplay has been revamped too, including, yes, combat. There are new finishers, new animations, and an adaptive camera. The skill tree has also been reimagined to offer more flexibility, and there's a transmogrification system, "immersive meditation" according to The Witcher 3 website, an expanded photo mode, cross-platform mod support and more.

A trailer for Remastered showed "enhanced combat", "improved traversal and movement", "enhanced monster behaviours", "improved mount handling", as well as the new skill tree and transmog system for you gear, and some of the new finishers.
As well as all this, the two existing expansions for The Witcher 3 - Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone - are also free for all owners of the base game as of this evening, too.

videos.summary: Revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live, our second gameplay trailer - Renegade, gives you a further glimpse into the protagonist, The Stranger.
body: We are showing you more of our mechanics, weaponry and combat both below and above ground.

We know how important the series is to our community, and we’re committed to crafting the ultimate METRO experience - one that draws on the very best of the series’ history, while dramatically expanding its scope for atmosphere, immersion and powerful storytelling.

If you’re fortunate enough to be at Gamescom yourself this year, we’d love to see you at our booth in Hall 9.1! Stop by while you’re here at the show and you’ll have the chance to lose yourself in the first demo of a METRO experience you’ll never forget.
points: Revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live, our second gameplay trailer - Renegade, gives you a further glimpse into the protagonist, The Stranger.

videos.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past | Official Teaser Trailer
videos.summary: Geralt returns to the Path in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past.
body: This full-fledged third expansion takes the White Wolf on a new adventure to the peaceful realm of Letten, where dark secrets lurk beneath the surface… Coming in 2027 to GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, Battle.net, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.
